correctness.rationale: Gale evenness identifies facets with k-edge cycle matchings; the omitted vertices in gaps g_i contribute matching rank Σfloor(g_i/2). Circular marked-gap compositions yield the exact coefficient n/s times binomial sum, including empty and simplex boundaries. For fixed k, overlapping adjacent-deletion edge selections vanish in factorial moments at scale q≈n^-1/2, yielding Poisson(c²); lower and upper tails proved by union bound and disjoint-edge binomial domination. Independently enumerated Gale facets, all 2^n candidate transversals and size counts for every admissible k with n=3..10; matched coefficients. Actual verify.py inspected.
residual_risks: Asymptotic assumes k fixed; no uniform growing-dimension statement.
Older cyclic-run or matching-number enumeration may already imply the full polynomial.
